text:
alejandra: Hi team — EdgeGuard is asking for a POC timeline + what we need from them to validate model fit. core asks: private data handling, latency targets (~150ms p95), and cost estimate for 100k tokens/day.

sam: Thanks. Quick checklist from eng side: 1) model artifacts (hf or tarball) or container image, 2) typical prompt length / max seq, 3) concurrency target. Do we have those?

alejandra: They sent a link to a private S3 with artifacts and a short spec: avg prompt 80 tokens, max 2048, peak concurrency 30. Link in DM.

mike_eng: OK. Two compatibility items to validate: 1) KV-cache compatibility for incremental chat (model needs causal attention + persistent KV layout), 2) quantized variant viability (4-bit). If they only give fp16 we may need a quantization pass which affects latency.

nina_sec: From security: they want SOC2 + our standard security questionnaire filled. Also asking about SSO (SAML) and customer-managed KMS for Private. I'll need the questionnaire to upload to their portal by Friday.

charlie_ops: For dedicated sizing: target 30 concurrency @ 2048 max -> rough estimate: 4x A10G-equivalent GPUs if unquantized, 2-3 if q4. I can run a quick perf sweep once we have model weights. Budget-wise that maps to ~$12k-$25k/mo depending on commit level and multi-zone.

alejandra: Good. Can we get a short runnable compatibility check we can hand to them? Something they can run and return results quickly?

mike_eng: I'll drop a tiny script. They can run locally and POST results. Example we can ask them to run:

```bash
# run on their side (python)
python -c "from model_check import probe; print(probe('s3://edgeguard/model.tar'))"
```

mike_eng: Internally we'll run the same probe with our quant/kv heuristics. If probe returns "kv_ok":true and "quant_suggest":"q4_0", we proceed to perf sweep.

remy-bot: deploy-bot created task #4521: run model compatibility scan when artifacts uploaded. (assigned to mike_eng)

nina_sec: Also ask them to complete the data flow diagram and list any third-party processors. That unlocks KMS & data retention conversation.

charlie_ops: One enterprise blocker we saw on a previous deal: if they require air-gapped on-prem with HSM, that moves to Private plan and increases lead time ~6-8 weeks for packaging. Need to surface that asap.

alejandra: I'll flag that to the customer: ask whether HSM or dedicated HSM is needed. If yes, we move to Private and update timelines.

sam: For pricing ask: we can provide two options in the POC proposal: 1) Hosted POC (no infra commit) with higher per-token rate; 2) Dedicated POC (reserved capacity, lower unit cost) — include an estimated range from charlie.

alejandra: Drafting email now. Nina — can you share the security questionnaire link and the short answers doc? Mike — can you attach the probe script gist? Charlie — can you confirm the rough cost ranges and note the SLA differences for Dedicated vs Hosted?

mike_eng: Will post gist and example output by EOD.

nina_sec: Uploading questionnaire to the shared drive: https://redwood.insecure/edgeguard-qa (internal). I'll add recommended responses for SSO, KMS, retention.

charlie_ops: Confirmed cost bands: Hosted POC: $0.06-$0.12 per 1k tokens (est) -> est monthly $6k-$12k for 100k tokens/day. Dedicated POC: $0.02-$0.05 per 1k tokens -> plus reserved capacity starting at $10k/mo. SLA 99.9% for Dedicated vs best-effort for Hosted.

alejandra: Perfect. I'll send to customer and ask for artifacts upload + completed questionnaire today. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: One last thing — if the model has nonstandard architecture (mixture-of-experts, custom attention), call out early; that can add months.

alejandra: Noted. I'll add that to the email.

mike_eng: FYI, if they only provide a container image we can still run the probe but need run instructions and a lightweight health endpoint.

alejandra: Got it. Closing thread after POC kickoff.
